# Remotion Templates by React Video Editor

Source: https://github.com/reactvideoeditor/remotion-templates (commit 6209b72, April 2026)
Created by the team at https://www.reactvideoeditor.com

The upstream README states: "All templates in this repository are available under the MIT License. You can use them in personal and commercial projects, but attribution is appreciated where applicable."

These 81 files are kept unmodified as reference. They are demo components with built-in sample data, so they are not imported directly; their animation techniques are ported into the themed, prop-driven scenes in `src/scenes/` (camera shake, particle burst, film grain, chart and donut reveals). Ported code credits this library in a comment.
